_storage_help: output_dir and stills_dir may be absolute paths on another drive, e.g. "E:/HERE_AM_I/renders". Use the drive that scan_setup.py lists under storage_suggestion.
_model: Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B GGUF Q4_K_M + lightx2v 4-step LoRAs (2 high-noise + 2 low-noise steps, cfg 1, shift 5), RIFE x3 to 48 fps; assemble_film.py conforms to 24 fps.
_stills_model: Z-Image Turbo GGUF Q8_0, 8 steps, cfg 1 (the still negative is not used at cfg 1).
_edit_model: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 GGUF Q4_0 + Lightning 4-step; up to three reference images.
_upscale_model: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI, RTX GPUs only, no download), 24 fps in, 1920x1088 out.
